text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket trains hard for the Osaka 
Hai. But despite all her effort, her times 
show no sign of improving.

To somehow turn the situation around, she 
ran a mock race with Narita Taishin and 
Biwa Hayahide, but her time still wouldn't 
improve.

When Winning Ticket says she was just glad 
they could have an awesome race, Biwa 
Hayahide asks if she really feels no 
frustration at losing.

Winning Ticket was baffled, not 
understanding the question's meaning. Even 
so, she fired herself up to give it her 
all with a positive attitude.
